name: ai-benchmark-expert
description: Benchmark LLMs the way serious leaderboards do: hand the SAME task to many providers and models as headless CLI subagents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode/MiniMax, mm-run or any command), run hidden deterministic checks in isolated workdirs, score the anonymised output with a blind LLM judge on an 8-dimension weighted rubric, and publish a single self-contained interactive HTML report — leaderboard with tiers, quality-vs-cost Pareto chart, efficiency bars, rubric heatmap, sortable table, per-run evidence, methodology — that you can share as one file. Methodology modelled on akitaonrails' LLM coding benchmark, BenchLM, the Open LLM Leaderboard, SWE-bench and Aider.
